participant_id.Description: BIDS label = number of the release folder (subNN_<id>); the release orders participants by age, as Table 1 (P1-P13) of Miles et al. 2025

release_id.Description: Pseudonymous identifier used in the release folder and file names

age.Description: Age at recording in years (Miles et al. 2025, Table 1; identical to the age column of the release montage files)

group.Description: Epilepsy patient undergoing intracranial ECoG monitoring

electrodes.Description: Implanted electrodes (Table 1; L/R hemisphere; counts in parentheses)

diagnosis.Description: Source: preprint Introduction ('monitoring for treatment-resistant epilepsy')

implant_type.Description: ECoG grids/strips; '(+depth)' when Table 1 lists depth electrodes
implant_type.Source: bioRxiv preprint doi:10.1101/2025.08.21.671637 (Miles, Weaver, Webb, Ojemann 2025) Table 1 'Electrodes'

implanted_hemisphere.Description: From L/R in Table 1 Electrodes column
implanted_hemisphere.Source: bioRxiv preprint doi:10.1101/2025.08.21.671637 (Miles, Weaver, Webb, Ojemann 2025) Table 1

regions_analyzed.Description: Verbatim 'Analyzed' column (MFG, PrCG, PoCG, SMG, STG, MTG)
regions_analyzed.Source: bioRxiv preprint doi:10.1101/2025.08.21.671637 (Miles, Weaver, Webb, Ojemann 2025) Table 1
